Target unchanged; the Source section's line numbers predate #26804 (merged 23:43Z) and #26758. Readings on the new main (read-only pass, this seat verified the shape):

- `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` (587 lines): modes are `page | drawer | split | new_window | none`; faces drawn are the drawer (Sheet, `:431`) and the split pane (`:530`); the drawer header is `SheetHeader` `:484`, title `:486-488` (`resolvedTitle = title || t('detail.recordDetail')`), expand `Maximize2` icon-only `:498-507`, close `:509-518`; no previous / next, no counter. The split face draws its own `h3` title and close and no expand button.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` (215 lines): returns `{ listRecordActions, navOverlay, handleDrawerClose, handleRowClick, handleExpandDrawer }`; `RECORD_DRAWER_PARAM` (`app-shell/src/urlParams.ts:86`, `'recordId'`) read at `:107`; one open record, no stack; `handleExpandDrawer` closes the drawer and navigates to `record/:id` with router state `{ from: { pathname, label } }`.
- `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx` passes `title={objectLabel(objectDef)}` — that is the object name the bar shows today (ruling 2 removes it).
- `RelatedRecordActionsBridge.tsx:553` `onView: (id) => openRecord(objectName, id)`; `:390-394` `openRecord` = `recordPath` + `navigate(path)`; no `embedded` branch; mounted at `RecordDetailView.tsx:3980` for both embedded and page use. A lookup value measured now: `ReferencedRecordLink` (`fields/src/index.tsx` ~2520-2565) → `host.openRecord` → the same `navigate` — identical to the related-row path, so one handler covers both.
- An existing URL trail already exists for page navigation: `recordPath` appends `?from=` (`RECORD_TRAIL_PARAM`, `appendRecordTrail`) when a parent is known. The in-drawer trail of this card composes with it rather than adding a second trail carrier.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx` has no `NavigationOverlay` / `RECORD_DRAWER_PARAM` today: the page-over-drawer host (Target 4) is new wiring.
- Churn: `ObjectView.tsx` is carved into sibling hooks almost hourly and `RecordDetailView.tsx` took four commits on 2026-10-27; #26966 (draft) edits RecordDetailView's action-variant region.
